INSERT INTO reported_splits (asset_id, date, new, old, sync_logical_timestamp, sync_origin, sync_device_id)
               VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
               ON CONFLICT(asset_id, date) DO UPDATE SET
                   new = excluded.new,
                   old = excluded.old,
                   sync_logical_timestamp = excluded.sync_logical_timestamp,
                   sync_origin = excluded.sync_origin,
                   sync_device_id = excluded.sync_device_id
